name: Severity
instructions: Rate the severity of the reported export problem using the ordered levels. Consider whether the task can still be completed with a practical workaround.

levels.label: Cosmetic
levels.description: A visual issue that does not prevent the task from being completed normally.

levels.label: Workaround Available
levels.description: The normal path fails, but a practical workaround allows the task to be completed.

levels.label: Fully Blocked
levels.description: The task cannot be completed and no practical workaround is available.
